tts_prompt_ph: What the reference clip says; optional
tts_sovits_down: {engine} is not running. The client starts it automatically; you can also click Start. Check the local log if deps or weights are missing
tts_sovits_need_ref: Choose a GPT-SoVITS reference clip first (3–10s of clear speech)
tts_sovits_started: {engine} launched. Wait until weights finish loading
tts_sovits_missing: GPT-SoVITS runtime not found. Run scripts/setup-gptsovits.ps1 or set SUBFLOW_GPTSOVITS_HOME
drop: Drop a video here, or click to choose
out_ph: Full file path, or browse to pick a folder
asr_help: Whisper is the default built-in engine. WhisperX is more precise per word; the client uses a bundled or auto-prepared runtime and falls back to Whisper if it is not ready.
tts_help: Dubbing uses the bundled GPT-SoVITS runtime. The client starts it automatically. Pick a reference clip, or SubFlow cuts 3–8s from the source. The official exe does not ship Torch weights.
need_url: Paste a YouTube or Bilibili URL first
need_model: Fetch and choose a translation model first
out_same: Output path cannot be the source video
token_saved: Token saved. Fetch models to choose one.
reused_log: Exported to the new path, {n} cues
error_reference_help: The reference audio is missing or unusable. Choose 3–10 seconds of clear speech, or clear the reference setting to extract audio from the current video.
error_translation_help: Recognition results are preserved. Continue translation to retry this task. To change the API token or translation model, close this dialog, update the settings, then click Continue.
error_generic_help: The request could not be completed. Open the details, check the service and input settings, then try again.
error_timeout_help: The speech request timed out. CPU synthesis can be slow. Check the service log and increase the timeout if needed.
error_original_kept: The existing video retains its original audio. Dubbing did not finish.
tts_sample_tip: Changes with the target language. Edit this text to change what the preview says.
tts_voice_origin_tip: Native language: {language}. Other target languages are supported; preview the accent and pace.
ui_subtitles_hint: One line per language, with consistent size and placement.
ui_original_voice: Source and target languages match. The original audio will be kept.
tts_designed_tip: Designed for {language} using Qwen VoiceDesign; not an official preset. Preview the voice, accent and pace.
resume_translation: Translation is incomplete. Click Continue to retry using the saved transcript.
resume_translation_running: Resuming translation with the saved transcript and translation cache.
asr_fallback: WhisperX is unavailable. Continuing recognition with Whisper.
